input_requirement: The payment service shall be available 100% of the time, including during maintenance windows and infrastructure upgrades.

ambiguities.explanation: The phrase '100% of the time' lacks a measurable boundary, making it unclear what percentage of time the service can be temporarily unavailable during maintenance windows and infrastructure upgrades without violating the requirement.
possible_interpretations: The payment service is available for 99.999% of the total time (5 minutes of downtime per year).
The payment service is available for 99.9% of the total time (43 minutes and 20 seconds of downtime per hour).

missing_information: A measurable boundary defining what constitutes '100% of the time' (e.g. a specific number of minutes or seconds of downtime per hour, day, or year).
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text provides no numeric threshold or explicit scope definition for '100% of the time', and no controlled context is available to supply one.
